visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a tight, full-body black suit stands in a minimalist white-walled hallway, gesturing wildly and making exaggerated mocking facial expressions toward the camera. Yellow and pink text overlays appear at the bottom. (2) A young woman with long reddish-brown hair, wearing a pink and white striped shirt, stands in a brightly lit indoor setting, looking annoyed with her hands on her hips. (3) The man in the black suit continues his energetic, taunting dance, representing a personified skin blemish. (4) Close-up on the woman's face as she inspects her forehead and chin, touching spots with her fingers. Visual emoticons like angry red icons and spirals appear around her head to indicate frustration. (5) The woman holds a white tube of Vita brand skincare product toward the camera, transitioning to a scene where she washes her face with a thick, white foam. (6) Hand-drawn bubble animations and foam effects are superimposed over the 'blackhead man,' who reacts with distress and surprise. (7) Comparison shots of the woman's forehead appear on screen, labeled with 'Before' and 'After' text to show skin texture improvement. (8) Detailed close-ups of two white product tubes, 'Mandelic Acid' and 'Cleanser Cream,' are presented against a plain grey background. (9) The woman demonstrates the foaming process, rubbing her hands together to create a dense lather and applying it to her face while looking into the lens. (10) The woman sits at a desk typing on a laptop, then touches her cheek to show off a smooth, hydrated complexion. She concludes by speaking directly to the camera while holding the products.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, mocking male voice taunts in Traditional Chinese over a fast-tempo, upbeat electronic synth track. High-frequency 'ping' sound effects punctuate each of his movements. (2) A transition whoosh leads into a female narrator with a clear, high-energy tone. She speaks at a rapid conversational rate about skin concerns. (3) Cartoon-style impact sounds and 'bubble' pops are mixed in as she demonstrates the product. The electronic BGM remains constant with a strong rhythmic drive. (4) Distinct 'ding' sound effects signal the appearance of on-screen text and graphical icons like angry faces. (5) Splash and liquid friction sounds are audible during the face-washing demonstration, layered beneath the dominant female speech. (6) The audio concludes with a final stinger sound effect and a rhythmic swell of the background music as the speaker delivers a closing call to action.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Problem Identification -> Solution Presentation -> Feature Breakdown -> Evidence/Results -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote Vita skincare cleansers by using a comedic personification of blackheads (the man in the bodysuit) to illustrate common skin problems, followed by a detailed demonstration of the products' effectiveness in resolving those issues and achieving 'boiled egg' skin.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product demonstration, branding (Vita), listing of specific ingredient ratios, and a call-to-action with promotional link information.
